Hi there hello. Today were checking in on the animals, and I regret to inform you that they are going through some stuff. We’ve got wild turkeys terrorizing a Wisconsin town, camels getting kicked out of beauty contests for cosmetic enhancements, a bear living under someones house like thats just a normal thing to do, a crying horse toy accidentally becoming a cultural icon, and dolphins launching themselves onto shore in a way that feels both intelligent and deeply concerning.

So yes, animals continue to be beautiful, majestic, and a little too comfortable making bizarre choices in public. If you enjoy quietly observing nature spiral into chaos from a safe distance, welcome aboard.

title: Weird Animal News You Missed While Being Human
